half_read: tool side: C# extractor source plus ClientData/animationsources.txt, settings.txt, EQ/Sound/EffSounds.cs, SoundConstants.cs
paired_donor: LanternEQ-LanternUnityTools (consumer side; own catalogue in DC033)
count_notes: creatures = family headers in animationsources.txt (101 body-to-rig rows, 30 distinct rig codes in the Unity copy). classes = 0 class names found by grep in .cs files read. weapons, gear_sets, zones are not in this half, so null, not zero.
creature_families: dragon-type families sharing one skeleton (4 families)
winged humanoid guardian with an imp family on the same rig
shelled crawler on a spider-type rig code
feline pack: 4 cat families on one rig
horned brute on a shared rig code
winged beasts (3 families) on one rig code
serpent and ghost dragon on one dragon rig code

top_creatures.label: Dragon family on one skeleton
top_creatures.why: Four dragon-type families share one skeleton, so one rig gives a whole family of silhouettes at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: one skeleton for the whole dragon family
top_creatures.change: silhouette from wing and crown meshes, not palette

top_creatures.label: Winged stone guardian
top_creatures.why: Winged humanoid with a still idle; reads as a threat before it moves.
top_creatures.change: jagged wings and an ember chest core

top_creatures.label: Shelled crawler
top_creatures.why: Low wide silhouette with a quick scuttle; reads as a swarm at distance.
top_creatures.change: spiked ridge and a burrow-up attack

top_creatures.label: Feline pack
top_creatures.why: Four cat families on one feline rig give four sizes from one animation set.

top_creatures.label: Horned brute
top_creatures.why: Heavy stride and horned head read at distance.
top_creatures.change: antler spread, chain belt, dust ring on stomp

top_creatures.label: Undead on living rigs
top_creatures.why: Undead reuse humanoid clips, so new undead cost no new animation.
top_creatures.keep: shared humanoid rig with a different idle
top_creatures.change: bone-gap silhouette and a rattle sound

top_creatures.label: Winged beasts on one rig code
top_creatures.why: Three winged families share one rig code, so one animation set covers them.
top_creatures.change: wing shape and ground stance (flight is inferred from family names)

top_creatures.label: Wyrm and ghost dragon
top_creatures.why: A serpent and a spectre share one dragon rig code, so they read as one family.
top_creatures.change: ghost trail and a ground-coil idle

looks.label: Region-split zone mesh export
looks.technique: export option: one combined mesh, or one mesh per BSP region

looks.label: Hidden geometry as collision-only boundaries
looks.technique: export switch for invisible boundary geometry

looks.label: Sound instances with emit and loop types
looks.technique: emitter type on a placed sound: one-shot emit or looping ambience

looks.label: Fixed-length binary sound record
looks.technique: 84-byte flat record with position, radius, type and sound ids; no header

originals.name: Shared-rig dragon brood
originals.idea: One dragon skeleton, four silhouettes: a family of dragons from one animation set.
originals.change: wing and crown silhouettes, own breath effect, no palette copy

originals.name: Ember-core guardian
originals.idea: A winged stone guardian that stays still until it sees a player, then unfolds jagged wings.
originals.change: jagged wings, ember chest core, stone sound

originals.name: Swarm crawler
originals.idea: A low shelled crawler that comes in packs and burrows up to attack.

originals.name: Feline pack
originals.idea: Four feline sizes from one rig, one pack leader with a pounce.

originals.name: Undead on living rigs
originals.idea: Undead reuse the humanoid rig and get a bone-gap silhouette and rattle.
originals.change: bone-gap silhouette, rattle sound, own idle

originals.name: Region-streamed zones
originals.idea: Zones split into region meshes and streamed or culled by region.
originals.change: region size set to our own tile grid
